extra.motion: The drone climbs and tilts slowly forward from looking down the motorway to looking along it, revealing the camp running on for miles to the horizon. Below, people keep walking between the tents, smoke drifts sideways across the lanes from dozens of fires, and the brazier flames flicker. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so anything moving fast smears with natural motion blur. One continuous shot, no cuts.
